strengths.point: Capital efficiency is high - the business earns well above a normal cost of capital.
Shareholder capital is compounding at a high rate.
Profit compounding has been strong over five years.
The balance sheet is effectively debt-free.
Reported profit is fully backed by operating cash.
The DCF puts intrinsic value well above the market price.

strengths.point: Interest cost is trivial next to operating profit.

strengths.point: Sales has compounded at a decent five-year clip.
The sales trend has been rising for 7 years in a row.
The reserves trend has been rising for 7 years in a row.
The return on capital trend has been rising for 4 years in a row.

opportunities.point: The company's order book is very healthy.

threats.point: A fast-growing debt load raises the stakes on execution.
Management noted that the cyclical nature of the lead industry and international price volatility can impact profitability.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The cyclical nature of the Lead industry and volatility in the international prices for Lead can affect the profitability of the company." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

threats.point: Management stated that a lack of availability of raw materials at economical prices could also affect profitability.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "Lack of availability of raw materials at economical prices could also affect the profitability." (annual report - 2025-03-31)

threats.point: The company's major customer is setting up its own lead smelter which will affect total volume offtake and could impact sales.
threats.evidence: Risk disclosed in the filings: "The company’s major customer, Amara Raja Batteries Limited is setting up their own Lead smelter, and will commence operations in the coming months. This will affect the total volume offtake and could have an impact on the sales of your company." (annual report - 2024-03-31)

threats.point: Small size brings liquidity and volatility risk.
Historically weak quarters (Mar, Sep) are still in the cycle.

swot.verdict: Strengths dominate the evidence (S30/W17/O23/T10), led by 'Capital efficiency is high - the business earns well above a normal cost of capital', with 50 points of weight still sitting on the weakness, opportunity and threat side.
